concepts.title: Moonlit Court: Masked Player vs. Skeleton
concepts.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: new wide horror-comic visual concept for a side-view ragdoll volleyball game, landscape 16:10.
Input images: all FOUR supplied images are STYLE REFERENCES ONLY. Image 1: irregular ink-mask portrait, worn ochre clothing and rough outlines. Image 2: classic horror comic with thick black contours and coarse print dots. Image 3: stark stippled hooded skeletons and large black voids. Image 4: flat violet / mint creatures, angular hatching and broad spot-color areas. Borrow their drawing and printing style, not the exact composition or existing character identities.
Primary request: two original horror characters playing volleyball in a restrained, slightly minimalist nighttime scene. Fully hand-drawn, flat ink comic / vintage screen-print art. Completely abandon all hotel and holiday-resort fiction.
Background: sparse moonlit clearing. Broad uninterrupted dusty periwinkle sky occupies most of the background; one small aged-cream moon, one low distant black silhouette band, two sparse bare-tree silhouettes restricted to the outer corners. Three large simple depth layers, abundant quiet negative space. No detailed forest, foliage texture, clouds full of hatching, buildings, hotel, sea resort, glass dome, city, windows or decorative scenery. Texture is subtle printing grain across flat color, not visual clutter.
Characters: exactly TWO full-body horror volleyball opponents. On the left an original masked figure leaping toward the ball: a worn ochre brimmed hat, indigo cloth face covering with a few irregular black ink patches, short fluttering ochre coat, dark-violet trousers, gloves and boots. On the right a complete bone-cream SKELETON with black eye sockets, unmistakable skull, exposed rib cage and thin readable limb bones, plum athletic shorts, bent knees and bony hands raised to receive. Expressive articulated ragdoll poses; distinct silhouettes and generous separation.
Court: straight side-on gameplay camera, horizontal playing floor at approximately 84% image height, shallow dark foreground strip. A single thin upright net pole at the exact center, viewed edge-on, not a broad front-facing volleyball net. One clearly visible cream/mint volleyball above the central area. Two minimal plain boundary posts at the extreme edges. Players approximately one quarter of frame height, both full bodies unobstructed.
Style: bold irregular black ink outlines, hard-edged flat spot colors, large solid black shadows, sparse scratchy hatching only inside characters, muted periwinkle, plum, mint, ochre and aged cream. Coarse halftone and subtly worn paper texture as in the references. Expressive vintage horror comic anatomy. Character detail is richer than the simple backdrop. No smooth digital rendering.
Constraints: a cohesive single landscape scene, no typography, UI, title, watermark or panels. No hotel staff, service robots, drones, wrapped gifts, luggage, hospitality motifs, narrative props, extra figures, weapons, blood or gore. No photorealism, 3D, smooth gradients, realistic bloom, dense decorative hatching or noisy background. Opaque background.

concepts.title: Shadow Arena: Hooded Skeleton vs. Werewolf
concepts.prompt:
Use case: style-transfer
Asset type: revised wide horror-comic concept for a side-view ragdoll volleyball game, landscape 16:10.
Input images: Image 1 is the EDIT TARGET, the recently drawn hooded-skeleton vs. werewolf indoor volleyball concept. Images 2–5 are the user's STYLE REFERENCES: ink-mask portrait, classic slasher comic, stippled hooded skulls, flat violet/mint creature comic.
Primary request: keep the two drawn horror player designs and the volleyball action, but REMOVE the entire hotel / resort narrative and radically simplify the background into a quiet, minimally suggested shadow arena. Background must be noticeably less busy than Image 1.
Keep: the ivory-boned hooded skeleton on the left, torn violet hood and short cloak, visible rib cage, exposed articulated limb bones, flailing airborne pose; the upright mint-green werewolf on the right, jagged violet mane, torn violet shorts, open clawed hand reaching for the ball. Preserve their strong black ink linework, original character identities and roughly the same scale. Preserve the one ball, single slim edge-on central net pole, continuous horizontal floor and readable left/right court framing.
Remove completely: both quadcopter drones, gifts, spring machine, luggage porter, robots, service buttons, palm trees, resort balconies, glass dome, dense window grids, hanging plants, detailed ceiling, realistic reflections, all hotel or hospitality references.
New background: a bare, eerie enclosed court suggested with only TWO broad dark side piers and ONE distant simple pointed arch silhouette. A large uninterrupted muted deep-violet / periwinkle wall plane sits behind the characters, calm and low-detail, with wide empty regions. A few sparse pale mint blocks inside the distant arch hint at cold light. Court floor is one plain dark horizontal slab with just two broken flat mint marks for contact / movement; no shiny reflection field. Minimal architecture, no engraved patterns, skull decorations, bricks, piles of objects, spectators, windows or new props.
Style: match the references' bold 2D horror comic / old screen-print language: thick rough black outlines, flat violet and mint inks, bone-cream highlights, large solid black areas, coarse but restrained halftone dots and subtle paper wear. Confine most angular hatching and stipple to the characters; keep background broad and calm. Clear skeleton and wolf silhouettes are the focal point.
Constraints: exactly two complete horror players, one ball, center net pole, landscape side view, same approximate court proportions. No text, labels, HUD, panels, watermark, weapons, blood or gore. No CGI, photorealism, smooth gradients, volumetric light, excessive grain or busy foliage / architecture. Opaque background.
